description: Link this card to another. `type` is one of the catalog values ("clones" is set automatically by Zuuna and is refused here). `direction` (outward|inward, default outward) picks which card is the semantic SOURCE for a non-symmetric type — e.g. outward "blocks" means THIS card blocks the target. A scheduling type (fs/ss/ff/sf) may carry lagDays and is refused if it would create a dependency cycle.

card.description: Card key (e.g. "ZNA-2001") or card id. Both work everywhere a card is addressed.

targetCard.description: The other card's key or id.
